byteAtlas.prompt: Produce a real animated-gameplay sprite sheet for original Aura Farmer character BYTE BADDIE. First reference locks her identity/costume: adult female, vivid hot pink ponytail, black knit crown beanie, black/pink jacket, white top, black baggy trousers, pink/black/white chunky shoes, pink-key chunky melee keyboard. Second reference is Pixel Vixen's gameplay atlas, ONLY for matching the chibi cartoon-arcade scale, crisp outline, cel shading and readable mobile-game sprite style. Do NOT copy Pixel Vixen's blue costume or gun. Draw Byte Baddie as a compact chibi game character with large expressive head and coherent proportions in EVERY pose. Transparent PNG sprite atlas, intended canvas 1024x1536. Exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows: exactly 24 separate complete character drawings. Each cell is 256x256, use 32px clear transparent gutters on every edge, whole hair, shoes and keyboard must fit each cell with no overlap, camera scale constant, standing feet on a common baseline at cell-local y=224, centre body at x=128. No text, no state labels, no grid lines, no scenery, no ground shadows, no extra icons or particles crossing cells, no watermark. The same BYTE BADDIE in all 24 cells, same outfit, skin, pink hair and keyboard. Three-quarter view facing screen right, readable overhead arena-game perspective, not side-scrolling flat silhouettes. Keep anatomy, hands, beanie and weapon consistent. Actual isolated production sprites with genuine transparent alpha, not a mockup of a spritesheet. Prioritize correct complete 4x6 layout and distinct animation states.
